notes: Blackmagic renamed this product from "Web Presenter HD" to "Streaming Encoder HD" (same SKU family, BDLKWEBPTRPRO / BDLKWEB/C/SEDHD); the manufacturer's current tech-specs page lists it under the new name but describes the identical unit. HDMI monitor output's HDMI version and the USB-C webcam port's USB generation are not stated in the spec sheet, so no grade was assigned to either (grade omitted per instructions when unstated). AC inlet is a standard IEC C14 (confirmed via multiple retailer/review descriptions of the internal 100-240V AC supply requiring a separate IEC cord, not included). Desktop/portable unit (one-third rack width) with an optional accessory shelf to rack-mount three units together — not itself assigned rackUnits since it is not a full rack-width chassis. SDI ports are physically BNC connectors carrying SDI signal, graded to the highest supported rate (12G) as stated ("1.5G, 3G, 6G, 12G" auto-switching).
